title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks
program_type: EU doctoral training programme under Horizon Europe (MSCA Doctoral Networks), administered by the European Research Executive Agency
duration: Doctoral Networks can last up to 4 years, up to 5 years for Joint Doctorate projects. Each individual fellowship is between 3 and 36 months, or 3 to 48 months for Joint Doctorate fellowships.
description: MSCA Doctoral Networks implement doctoral programmes through international, intersectoral partnerships of universities, research institutions, businesses including SMEs and other socio-economic actors, in order to train highly skilled doctoral candidates. Besides standard Doctoral Networks, the action promotes Industrial Doctorates, which place PhD candidates largely outside academia, and Joint Doctorates, which lead to a joint or multiple doctoral degrees. title: France Excellence Europa Scholarship
official_source: Campus France (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs)
program_type: Government scholarship of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, managed by Campus France
duration: A maximum of 12 months when enrolling in Master 2 and a maximum of 24 months when enrolling in Master 1. The stay must begin between 1 September and 31 December of the year the scholarship is awarded, and no deferral is possible.
description: The France Excellence Europa scholarship programme, developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and managed by Campus France, lets students from 26 EU Member States study at Master's level at a French higher education institution. It pays a semi-annual maintenance allowance of EUR 6,850 and a one-off installation allowance of EUR 1,700, exempts holders from administrative registration fees for a national degree in public institutions and from the CVEC, and arranges social protection and complementary health insurance. title: France Excellence Major Scholarship
official_source: AEFE (Agency for French Education Abroad) / French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
program_type: Government scholarship of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, awarded by AEFE and managed financially by Campus France
duration: Five years of study in France, referenced by AEFE to the time needed to obtain a Master 2 or equivalent; about 800 foreign students are supported at any time, with around 200 new holders joining each year.
description: France Excellence-Major is a French government scholarship run by AEFE for the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs that supports the best non-French baccalaureat holders from the network of French schools abroad to continue their higher education in France. Around 800 foreign students are supported at any one time over five years of study, and about 200 new holders join each year. title: Humboldt Research Fellowship
official_source: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation (German Federal Foreign Office)
duration: Postdocs: 6 to 24 months, divided into up to three stays within three years. Experienced researchers: 6 to 18 months, divided into up to three stays within three years.
description: The Humboldt Research Fellowship sponsors researchers with above-average qualifications from across the globe to conduct their own research at a German host institution. For postdocs the monthly fellowship amount is €3,000 and for experienced researchers €3,600, plus additional benefits. On top of the fellowship amount the Foundation provides family benefits for children and partners, subsidies for private full health insurance, and travel expense allowances, as well as personal support throughout the sponsorship.
